关键词: Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement
主要内容: PACIFICHEALTH LABORATORIES, INC. terminated its employment agreement with Chief Executive Officer Frederick Duffner, effective January 2, 2013, by mutual agreement. Despite the non-renewal, Mr. Duffner continues to serve as CEO. The company also terminated its consulting agreement with Signal Nutrition LLC, a company owned by one of its directors, by mutual agreement. The termination does not preclude future business relationships with Signal Nutrition LLC. The report was filed on January 7, 2013, and signed by Chief Financial Officer Stephen P. Kuchen.
